title: GTA 6's Lucia Was Trained to Fight Before She Could Walk 🥊 #Shorts
description:
Lucia Caminos, per Rockstar's official GTA VI bio: her dad taught her to fight as soon as she could walk, defending her family led to Leonida Penitentiary, and she got out through good luck. Source: rockstargames.com/VI (Lucia and Jason pages). Footage: official Rockstar trailers.
